name: CAAFI (Commercial Aviation Alternative Fuels Initiative)
notes: Live CAAFI site, free to browse and described as a reference database for alternative jet fuels. Because the site reserves copyright with no stated reuse terms, the record's reuse_level full-text-open overstates what is permitted and is corrected to full-text-restricted; licence remains unknown.
